name: Sierra Leone
summary: Green, white and blue horizontal bands. Adopted at independence from Britain on 27 April 1961, its colours come from the coat of arms granted in 1960.
origin: The College of Arms granted Sierra Leone its coat of arms in 1960, showing a lion, a torch and wavy lines. The flag's colours were drawn from the arms and raised at independence in 1961.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: Agriculture, the mountains and natural resources.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The natural harbour of Freetown and hope for a contribution to world peace.

history.label: Colony of Sierra Leone
history.note: Blue ensign with an elephant and palm badge.

facts: Freetown's harbour is one of the largest natural harbours in the world.
Gabon's flag is green, yellow and blue; Sierra Leone's middle band is white.
clues: Green, white and blue horizontal bands.
Its blue stands for a great natural harbour.
Its colours came from a coat of arms granted the year before independence.
